Name: Shared Bookies
Author: Wortax15
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod makes it so that when one player reads a power book, it is automatically added to every other player’s powers[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requires SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Can be used in an already existing save[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Compatible with Button's Extra Books, More Books mods & JP's Merchant's Books[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]respectively https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21526, https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23891 & https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43034[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: SharedBookies
Manifest.Description: A mod to share power books effects between players
